subject: general
question: In 2025, why did National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) and Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) sign an agreement?

options.text: To improve farming that can handle climate change

solution:
The correct answer is __**To improve farming that can handle climate change**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **2025**, the **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)** and the **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)** entered into a **Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** to foster a collaborative environment for **climate-resilient agriculture**.
 
• The primary objective of this agreement is to integrate **ICAR's cutting-edge research** and technological advancements with **NABARD's robust financial framework** to empower rural farmers against the adverse effects of **climate change**. ***Hence, the correct answer is option 2.***
 
• The partnership focuses on **technology transfer**, specifically the dissemination of **drought-resistant crop varieties** and advanced **irrigation techniques** to the grassroots level.
 
• It aims to promote sustainable farming practices</stron
